none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone operator root finding: F:E→E is globally L-Lipschitz and monotone, with F(x*)=0 and ‖x0−x*‖≤R. No objective or gradient representation is assumed. L>0 and R≥0.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Stochastic operator evaluations g(x,ξ) with independent identically distributed fresh seeds, E[g(x,ξ)]=F(x), and uniformly bounded central α-th moment. Each sampled evaluation counts as one oracle call; no sample reuse interface is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TailObliviousMonotoneRootFinding.lean: HeavyTailedOperator and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: E‖g(x,ξ)−F(x)‖^α≤σ^α for every x, with 1<α≤2 and σ≥0. Variance need not be finite when α<2.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension bound or bounded feasible domain is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only E, x0, and L are public. The algorithm cannot depend on α, σ, R, or ε, although the external fixed oracle budget depends on them.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over both algorithm randomness and the IID oracle seed sequence, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The output X must be measurable, ‖F(X)‖^α integrable, and E‖F(X)‖^α≤ε^α for ε>0. This is an operator residual moment criterion, not an objective gap or variational inequality gap.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Monotone Lipschitz root finding is classical, but this formulation combines potentially infinite-variance noise, an α-th residual moment guarantee, and an algorithm unaware of the moment order, noise scale, initial radius, and target accuracy.
